editions.text:
The whole day came to 180 feeder visits and 390 detections across 18 species, the fewest visits of the eight days shown, against a seven-day average of 326.7 visits. Detections were close to the 435.1 average, and the 18 species were below the 19.7 average. House Finch (88 heard) and Northern Cardinal (81 heard) led the detections, and Tufted Titmouse led the visits with 60. The first visual was a Tufted Titmouse 8 min before sunrise, and the last was a Carolina Wren 6 min after sunset.

Fourteen species were recorded on all seven days, including this one, among them Blue Jay, Carolina Chickadee, Carolina Wren, House Finch, Northern Cardinal and Tufted Titmouse. Gray Catbird, recorded on each of the previous seven days, was not yet recorded today. Pileated Woodpecker returned after 8 days away, last recorded 2026-10-09, with 3 heard and 1 at the 15:00 and 16:00 and 18:00 hours.

The audio source was switched repeatedly on this day, most densely from 07:25 to 08:10 and again from 18:23 to 21:06.
